authorization: User requests adding what remains to close and implementing the concrete audit improvements in the book.
timing: Registered before running the new supplemental calculations, after inspecting the original CV and reserved-test results. This is an explicitly post-hoc exploratory supplement, not pre-test registration or independent confirmation.
target: sigma7 population daily log-return SD; input histories7/14/21/28, horizon1 day, primaryrelative_window
frozen_selection: MLP/D7 baseline selected usingCV2024; LSTM/D7 andCNN1D/D7 also selected within family. No reselection from test.

final_inference.primary_temporal_family: Three neural pairs plus three neural-minus-deterministic-persistence pairs; squared loss averaged across seed trajectories by date; no ensemble prediction.
final_inference.seed_family: Six two-sided paired t contrasts of seed RMSE differences, Holm6, conditional on the calendar and approximate normality; marginal t95CI and dz.
final_inference.normality: Shapiro and QQ diagnostics, not proof of normality. Flag p<.05, no switching to whichever test rejects. Interpret assumptions and limitations explicitly.
final_inference.wilcoxon_scope: Separately adjusted signed-rank location sensitivity, exact only when supported by nonzero untied differences; symmetry assumption and discrete resolution explicit. Not a mean difference test or independent confirmation.
final_inference.dm_correction: Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold h1, BartlettHAC, primaryHolm6; bandwidth sensitivity descriptive.
final_inference.date_bootstrap: Paired circular common date blocks across all methods/seeds; compute each seed RMSE/MAE then mean; no retraining or seed resampling; marginal percentile intervals not simultaneous.
final_inference.seed_effect_bootstrap: Paired seed resampling for dz CI, separately labeled conditional on the same calendar and approximate with10pairs; no mixing with temporal uncertainty.
final_inference.mde: Retrospective normal-approximation design sensitivity for the six seed contrasts withplanningα=.05/6,power.8; not achieved power or a prospective pilot.
final_inference.relative_differences: Absolute/relative RMSE andMAE using fixed references identified byCV selection; full rankings descriptive, no test-driven baseline change.
final_inference.scope_limit: Different seed, temporal loss and resampling estimands are not independent confirmations. Do not use BDS to infer comparative precision.

descriptive.variance: Balanced monthly seed×model panel by D; descriptive orthogonal main effects/interactions/residual sum-of-squares, no ANOVA iid claim. Deterministic persistence excluded from seed factor.
descriptive.segments: Quantile boundaries estimated only on common permitted development outcomes through2024-12-03(D28purge); test error summaries use frozen boundaries.
descriptive.residuals: Bias/dispersion and binned residual diagnostics; monthly case summaries, no novel formalheteroskedasticity p-values required.
descriptive.public_figures: Only monthly averages/bands or bins withatleast10observations; no individual point scatter, prediction/target/residual vectors or daily market series.
descriptive.new_tuning: No test distribution or segment inspection may change model, preprocessing, epochs or dates.

advanced_planning.status: Scenario proposal for a future study; applied utility margin remains unvalidated without decision/cost context.
advanced_planning.baseline_anchor: Frozen CV2024 MLP/D7 mean RMSE and sample seed SD, never select baseline from test.
advanced_planning.inference_model: Paired normal differences hypothetical; report normal R approximation and noncentral-t R under each specified variance/correlation scenario.
advanced_planning.persistence_gate: Any future proposed gain against neural baseline must also be contextualized against the stronger deterministicpersistence reference. No financial benefit inferred from a statistical margin.

reproducibility: Full private bundle and isolated restoration with hashes; verifier only, no model forward/training/rawmarketZIP. Original markers and signed scientific files immutable.
publication: Explicit aggregate-only allowlists; no new individual prediction vectors, market derivatives, model checkpoints or full private archives. Do not upload the supplied course PDF.
